name: Futa Inn
source:
In the aftermath of a devastating war between Man and Futa, you decide to move back to your home town.

Your old friend sets you up with a job at the local inn! Here you'll make drinks, meet the townspeople and much more!

[From [url=https://afutafuture.itch.io/futa-inn]Itch.io[/url]]
